basis: MedPAC estimated MA payment difference versus similar FFS beneficiaries in CY2026; not budgetary recoverable savings
projections_not_additive: The $11B beneficiary-premium effect and $16B quality bonuses are mechanisms/impacts within the overall Medicare financing picture; they are NOT additional recoverable savings on top of the $76B comparison.
caveat: Not equivalent to recoverable MA spending or unified federal deficit reduction for any policy. Plan selection, bids, bonus structure, beneficiaries and premium offsets require modeling.
